messages:
beta-customer: Hey, we just hit 429s during a demo and our org credits show 0 in the dashboard but our account was upgraded mid-cycle to Pro on Mar 10. Will monthly tokens reset for us at midnight UTC or tenant local time? We also think a long streaming session ate our burst. Repro steps + logs below.

emma.support: Sorry about the outage — can you paste the org_id and approximate timestamps for the 429s? Also can you share the websocket session id if available?

beta-customer: org_id: org_9X7a. 429s started ~2026-03-09T23:45:00Z -> 2026-03-09T23:58:00Z. session id ws-7f3d. We upgraded March 10 02:15 UTC (billing page shows successful upgrade).

emma.support: thanks — quick answers: 1) Monthly refill happens at tenant billing timezone midnight (not necessarily UTC) and 2) plan upgrades are not retroactive for the current cycle (upgrade affects future billing cycles unless we issue an ad-hoc grant). Will escalate to billing to check why dashboard showed 0 after upgrade.

nate.billing: digging in ledger now. Emma — can you attach the invoice id or billing txn for the March 10 upgrade? If the upgrade completed after the tenant's billing cutoff, the refill won't apply until next reset. I see a pending upgrade txn from 2026-03-10T02:15:12Z for org_9X7a, will verify effective date.

beta-customer: invoice id inv_56321 attached in ticket INC-12345 (see link). But the dashboard zeroed out before the upgrade completed — we hit 0 at 2026-03-09T23:45Z, upgrade was ~2.5 hours later. We expected remaining Starter cycle tokens to still be there until the normal reset.

jiayi-eng: quick theory: the streaming session may be counting each keepalive/chunk as tokens if the client kept sending small input frames. Also long-lived streams can exhaust a 'burst' pool if continuous token accounting isn't throttled. Can you share a small snippet of the websocket traffic around ws-7f3d (just the client->server frames)?

beta-customer: pasted sample (redacted) below:
```
[2026-03-09T23:44:51Z] ws-7f3d SEND {"type":"input","seq":1234,"tokens":10}
[2026-03-09T23:45:10Z] ws-7f3d SEND {"type":"keepalive","seq":1235,"tokens":1}
[2026-03-09T23:45:21Z] ws-7f3d SEND {"type":"input","seq":1236,"tokens":50}
[2026-03-09T23:45:40Z] ws-7f3d SEND {"type":"input","seq":1237,"tokens":200}
[2026-03-09T23:46:05Z] ws-7f3d SEND {"type":"keepalive","seq":1238,"tokens":1}
```

jiayi-eng: thanks — I can already see many small frames + keepalives. Two things to check: 1) client-side batching (combine inputs before sending) and 2) server-side accounting: we have a known edge where keepalive frames were being double-counted for a short window (fixed in runtime 2026-02-28, but older dedicated pools might still have it). Are you on Hosted or Dedicated?

beta-customer: Hosted. No custom dedicated pool. We were surprised to see zero tokens before our upgrade completed.

nate.billing: Ledger lookup: org_9X7a had a monthly bucket of 1_000_000 tokens for Starter; consumed down to 0 by 2026-03-09T23:46:12Z. The upgrade txn effective_date is 2026-03-10T00:00:00 in tenant's billing timezone (America/Los_Angeles) so the upgrade moved them to Pro at local midnight — but the zero happened earlier. Seems consumption explains it. I can issue a 100k one-time credit while we investigate if you want.

beta-customer: A temporary grant would help our demo. Would you also confirm which timezone the dashboard shows for the reset? It showed UTC on our org settings page which confused us.

emma.support: Dashboard shows "Reset: local timezone" but UI cache can show UTC if your browser cached earlier settings. We'll clear server-side cache for the org and force a refresh.

sre-bot: INC-12345 created, assigned to jiayi-eng and nate.billing. Ticket link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-12345

jiayi-eng: next steps from eng side: 1) we'll audit the streaming-accounting logs for ws-7f3d to ensure keepalive frames weren't double-counted, 2) verify the runtime pool version for hosted nodes that served your org, 3) send a short postmortem if we find an accounting bug. If nothing is wrong we'll provide recommendations (client batching, reduce keepalive frequency).

nate.billing: credit grant processed: +100000 tokens to org_9X7a, effective immediately. Please confirm if you see the tokens in the dashboard (may take ~30s).

beta-customer: tokens visible now, demo resumed. Thanks. Can you send a short note on whether this was a billing boundary issue vs streaming accounting bug? We need that for our internal post-demo RCA.

emma.support: will follow up once eng confirms. For now: cause likely consumption from streaming session; upgrade timing explains no auto refill this cycle. We'll update INC-12345 with findings. :thumbsup:
